## What's new in v0.6.1

- **See where a copy came from:** a copy looks just like what it copies, so the game now names what made it. On the stack a copy's tag reads "Your copy · from Twincast". Hover or right-click a copy, on the stack or the table, for a line like "Token copy of Serra Angel · made by Saw in Half". The log says it too.

## Download

Download **ArenaEDH.exe** below and double-click it. There's nothing to install, and it runs on Windows 10 and 11.

The first time, Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the program isn't signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

To play with friends on other computers, everyone needs this same version.
